summary: Trigger pre-processing for a file (company scope, v2)
description: Company-level pre-process trigger without project_id in the path. Tools that require a project may return 400 from the service layer.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the item to pre-process

parameters.name: replace_existing
parameters.description: When true, replace any existing pre-processed artifacts

parameters.name: optimize
parameters.description: When true, request optimization passes where supported
